title: Clothing Repair & Sewing Basics
description: Builds an emergency sewing kit and teaches threading, tying off, and four hand stitches (running, back, whip, blanket). Walks through replacing buttons, patching, zipper fixes, hemming, and darning, plus repairing tents, tarps, backpacks, and sleeping bags.
shortDescription: Hand stitches, patches, buttons, zippers, and tent and pack repairs
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
